beats.shot: extreme close-up on a clear glass
beats.does: pours white vinegar from a plain glass jug onto fresh baking soda in the clear glass, causing a violent bubbling reaction
beats.says: Pour vinegar on your baking soda.

beats.shot: medium shot on Felix and Stella in the bright kitchen
beats.does: points directly at the camera while Stella gasps and nods vigorously behind him
beats.says: Test Number One: is it active?

beats.shot: close-up on the white quartz counter
beats.does: sets a clear glass of old baking soda directly next to a clear glass of fresh baking soda
beats.says: Fresh and old baking soda side by side.
beats.sound: glass clinking lightly on the counter

beats.does: pours white vinegar from the glass jug into both glasses; the fresh one bubbles rapidly, the old one stays flat

beats.shot: medium shot on Felix and Stella
beats.does: gestures confidently over the counter while Stella points at the bubbling glass with a wide-eyed, shocked expression
beats.says: It needs vinegar to react and release gas.

beats.shot: extreme close-up on the flat clear glass
beats.does: pokes the flat, wet baking soda sludge with a plain metal spoon
beats.says: If it just sits there, it is dead.

beats.shot: medium shot on Felix and Stella
beats.does: lifts the fizzing clear glass up to his chest, looking directly into the camera lens
beats.says: Dead baking soda ruins food. When did you buy yours?

caption: Is your pantry staple actually doing its job? When did you buy yours? #FoodFactCheck #BakingSoda #KitchenHacks
